_readme: Messages in chats listed in `internalChatIds` are saved to the internal archive server (`npm run archive:serve`) immediately, stay readable for `deleteDelaySeconds`, and are then deleted from Telegram for all participants. On every login/reconnect the latest 100 messages of each internal chat are also swept, so messages received while the app was closed are archived and deleted too. Ids use the same format as in hiddenChats.json: a user id for a person (e.g. "123456789"), a chat id with the leading minus for a group (e.g. "-1001234567890"). `archiveApiUrl` is the base URL of the archive server. Rebuild the app after editing.
